author: Poag
description: Logs what games members are playing in a server: who's playing what, and how long each session lasts. Only 'Playing' activities count as games; other statuses (Spotify, custom statuses, streaming, watching) are ignored. Requires the Presence and Server Members privileged intents to be enabled for the bot.
install_msg: Thanks for installing GameLog! This cog requires the Presence and Server Members privileged intents to be enabled for the bot in order to see game activity - see the repo README for details.
short: Logs per-session game activity for members.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per server: a Discord user ID, the name of each detected game activity, and the start time, end time, and duration of each play session. This is used only to answer in-server playtime queries via this cog's commands. All stored data for a user is deleted when Red processes a data deletion request for that user.
